description: For a company with a Pay2GPT business API key: open 1-100 orders of one product, each spending one of the company's credits for that product. Each order comes back with a redemption link for the end user. Reusing the same idempotency_key with the same arguments returns the same orders and spends nothing more. An order nobody has connected an account to can be given back with cancel_business_order.

idempotency_key.description: A unique key for this purchase, reused on retry

name: place_business_orders
title: Business: place orders
